description: Conversion of 'vehicle_sync: restores and publishes last known values': a Model S with trim P100D carries one seeded position (seed.positions, the original's row), the first fetch finds it asleep with only a display name, and the vehicle restores the seeded values into its first summary — latitude 37.889544, longitude 41.128817, battery level 64, odometer 91887.73, ranges, temperatures and the location JSON are published from the database, display_name bar and model S from the payload and car. The seeded row stays the only positions row; the asleep terminal repeats through the probe without writing.
